name: Fire Burst (Frog God Games)
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (existing fire source)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 10-ft.-radius circle
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause an existing fire source (ranging in size from a candle to a bonfire) to release arrows of flame outward in all directions, centered on the fire source. Creatures within 10 feet take 1 point of fire damage per caster level (maximum 10 points). A creature that makes a successful saving throw suffers no damage.
